name: KINTSUGI PORTRAIT
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a kintsugi vessel — Japanese repaired pottery in which breaks are rejoined with lacquer dusted in gold, treating the damage as history worth showing rather than a flaw to hide.

options.text: Fine gold seams tracing a spiderweb of hairline cracks across pale crackle glaze
Bold molten rivers of gold rejoining a few large fragments of dark raku clay
Silver and platinum mending on celadon, with one deliberate gold patch replacing a missing shard

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Every crack must read as a deliberate repair, never as damage
• Metal seams sit slightly proud of the glaze and catch light
• Pottery surface shows real ceramic depth and glaze pooling
• Subject's features remain readable through the vessel form

name: TALAVERA CERAMIC
message: Take a picture and render the subject as Talavera poblana — Mexican tin-glazed earthenware from Puebla, hand-painted over a milk-white glaze in a restricted palette dominated by deep cobalt blue.

options.text: Classic cobalt blue on white with dense floral scrollwork and a scalloped border
Full polychrome with cobalt, ochre, green and manganese black on white
Bold single-motif composition with wide negative space and a plain blue rim

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Hand-painted brush character with visible loading and lift
• Glaze pooling darker in recesses, slight surface pinholing
• Tin-glaze white must read as warm, not paper white
• Traditional Puebla motifs only

name: PORTUGUESE AZULEJO
message: Take a picture and turn it into a Portuguese azulejo tile panel — a large narrative scene painted in cobalt on tin-glazed tiles, assembled into a wall with visible grout lines cutting across the image.

options.text: Blue-and-white narrative panel with baroque cartouche border
Polychrome 17th century panel with yellow and manganese alongside the blue
Repeating geometric padrão tiles framing a central figurative medallion

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Grout lines must cross the image on a regular grid, interrupting the picture
• Slight glaze irregularity and tile-to-tile colour drift
• Brushwork visible as washes and hatching, not airbrush
• Subject remains the focus of the panel

name: DELFTWARE
message: Take a picture and paint it as Dutch Delftware — 17th century tin-glazed earthenware imitating Chinese porcelain, executed entirely in cobalt blue on a soft white ground.

options.text: Fine chinoiserie treatment with delicate stippled shading and a diaper border
Bold folk Delft with confident loose brushwork and a simple double blue rim
Delft plaque with a landscape vignette behind the subject and corner sprays

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Cobalt blue only, from pale wash to near-black saturation
• Tin glaze white with faint blue-grey cast
• Small glaze chips at the rim for age
• No modern colours anywhere

name: ROSEMALING
message: Take a picture and decorate it in Norwegian rosemaling — rural decorative painting built from C and S scrolls, flowing acanthus leaves and stylised blooms laid over a flat painted ground.

options.text: Telemark style with asymmetric flowing scrollwork on deep blue-green
Hallingdal style with dense symmetrical florals on a warm red ground
Rogaland style with tight cross-hatched detailing and a cream ground

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Long confident brushstrokes that taper naturally
• Transparent overstrokes layered on opaque base colour
• Painted wood grain showing through in worn areas
• Subject integrated into the scrollwork, not pasted over it

name: KHOKHLOMA
message: Take a picture and render it as Khokhloma — Russian lacquered woodware in which silver-leafed wood is painted and varnished until it turns a deep honeyed gold, then decorated in vermilion and black.

options.text: Classic gold ground with vermilion berries and curling black grasses
Black ground with dense gold foliage and red highlight accents
Under-painting style with the golden metal showing through fine black linework

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• The gold must read as warm lacquer over metal, never as flat yellow
• Vermilion, black and gold only
• Fine tapering grass strokes and rowan-berry clusters
• Glossy varnish with soft specular highlights

name: PYSANKA WAX RESIST
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a pysanka — a Ukrainian egg decorated by batik-style wax resist, each dye bath adding a colour while wax preserves what came before.

options.text: Traditional geometric bands of triangles, meanders and eight-point stars
Floral and wheat-sheaf motifs in warm ochre, red and deep brown
Fine white line work reserved against a near-black final dye bath

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Every line must read as wax-resisted, slightly raised and soft-edged
• Colours layer from light to dark as real dye baths do
• Egg curvature distorts the pattern toward the edges
• Subject's features simplified into the ornament

name: ADINKRA STAMPING
message: Take a picture and print it as Ghanaian adinkra cloth — hand-carved calabash stamps inked in dark bark dye and pressed in grids across cotton divided by combed lines.

options.text: Dense all-over stamping in blocks separated by hand-combed dividing lines
Sparse large symbols on undyed cotton with wide breathing space
Russet-dyed cloth with black stamping and a stitched panel seam

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Stamp impressions must vary — some light, some over-inked
• Grid is hand-set and slightly irregular
• Cloth weave texture visible throughout
• Subject formed from the massed stamp pattern

name: KENTE WEAVE
message: Take a picture and weave it as kente cloth — narrow strips of silk and cotton woven on a double-heddle loom then sewn edge to edge, so the image is built from interlocking warp and weft blocks.

options.text: Bold gold, green, red and black strips with alternating warp and weft blocks
Blue and white royal cloth with fine supplementary weft motifs
Dense multicolour strip work with visible hand-sewn joins between panels

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Image must be built from vertical strips of unequal width
• Thread-level texture with weft blocks reading as discrete units
• Colour can only change on a thread boundary, never gradually
• Subject recognisable from the massed pattern

name: BORO MENDED TEXTILE
message: Take a picture and render it as boro — Japanese cloth patched and repatched across generations, layers of indigo scrap held together by running sashiko stitch until the mending becomes the fabric.

options.text: Deep indigo layers with dense white running stitch and frayed patch edges
Faded pale indigo and undyed hemp patches with sparse repair stitching
Heavily built-up mending with a dozen overlapping scraps and visible wear holes

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Patch edges fray and lift; nothing is neatly hemmed
• Stitch lines run in rows and wander slightly off parallel
• Indigo fades unevenly with wear at folds and edges
• Subject emerges from the value differences between patches

name: ILLUMINATED MANUSCRIPT
message: Take a picture and set it as a page from an illuminated manuscript — vellum worked in egg tempera and burnished gold leaf by a monastic scriptorium, the subject held inside a decorated initial or miniature.

options.text: Historiated initial containing the subject, surrounded by vine scroll and gold ground
Full-page miniature with a diapered gold background and architectural frame
Marginal treatment with the subject among drolleries, ivy trails and gold bezants

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Gold must be burnished leaf with a raised gesso edge, not yellow paint
• Vellum tone warm with faint hair follicles and cockling
• Lapis blue and vermilion dominate the palette
• Flat medieval space with no cast shadows

name: SCRIPTORIUM MARGINALIA
message: Take a picture and place the subject in the margins of a medieval manuscript, drawn with the odd deadpan humour of a bored scribe — half-figures, impossible creatures and pointing hands crowding the edge of the text.

options.text: Subject as a hybrid grotesque emerging from an ivy trail
Subject drawn small and earnest beside a column of Latin text and a manicule
Subject in a bas-de-page scene running along the bottom of the written block

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Ink line first, thin colour washes second
• Text block present but illegible as generic script
• Slightly awkward medieval anatomy, drawn sincerely
• Vellum ground with age spotting

name: LETTERPRESS BROADSIDE
message: Take a picture and print it as a letterpress broadside — wood and metal type struck into thick cotton paper hard enough to leave a visible bite, with the subject rendered as a bold cut illustration.

options.text: Two-colour job in black and vermilion with mixed wood type sizes
Single black impression with heavy condensed gothic type and rules
Overprinted three-colour with deliberate misregistration at the edges

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Visible impression bite pressing into the paper
• Ink slightly heavier at letter edges, lighter in centres
• Deckle edge and cotton rag texture
• Type and image share the same flat ink

name: MEZZOTINT
message: Take a picture and work it as a mezzotint — a copper plate roughened all over then burnished back toward the light, so the image emerges out of a velvety black rather than being drawn into white.

options.text: Deep rich black ground with the subject burnished out in soft glowing halftone
Dramatic single-source lighting with most of the plate left at full black
Mezzotint with drypoint accents adding burr-heavy dark lines

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Tone must be continuous and grainless, never hatched
• Blacks are dense and slightly warm, never flat grey
• Highlights are burnished, with soft blooming edges
• Plate mark embossed into the paper

name: CYANOTYPE BOTANICAL
message: Take a picture and print it as a cyanotype — iron salts brushed onto paper and exposed to sunlight, giving Prussian blue where light struck and paper white where it did not.

options.text: Classic deep Prussian blue with visible hand-brushed coating edges
Toned cyanotype shifted toward violet-brown by a tannin bath
High contrast photogram treatment with the subject as a soft-edged silhouette

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Blue must be Prussian, cool and slightly granular
• Brush marks define an irregular border around the image
• Highlights are bare paper fibre, not white ink
• Long tonal shoulder with soft compressed highlights

name: DITHERED BITMAP
message: Take a picture and reduce it to a one-bit dithered bitmap — pure black and white only, all tone faked by scattering dots in ordered or diffused patterns the way early computers had to.

options.text: Floyd-Steinberg error diffusion with organic scattered grain
Ordered Bayer matrix dithering with a visible regular crosshatch
Coarse halftone dithering at large dot size for a printed-newsprint feel

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Exactly two values — pure black and pure white, no greys
• Dot pattern must be visible and structural, never blurred
• Edges break into dot noise rather than staying clean
• Subject readable at a squint

name: MOIRE INTERFERENCE
message: Take a picture and build it from moiré interference — two fine repeating line grids overlaid at a slight angle so the image appears only where the patterns beat against each other.

options.text: Concentric ring grids producing soft rippling contour bands
Straight parallel rule grids at a few degrees offset, banding diagonally
Radial fan grids creating a rotating shimmer around the subject

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Image must emerge from pattern interference, not from shading
• Line weight stays constant; only spacing and angle vary
• Strong optical vibration where frequencies collide
• Two ink colours maximum

name: EXPLODED TECHNICAL VIEW
message: Take a picture and redraw the subject as an exploded technical illustration — every component separated along its assembly axis, floating in ordered space with leader lines and part numbers.

options.text: Clean line-art exploded view with numbered callouts and a parts key
Ghosted view with outer layers rendered transparent over solid inner parts
Cutaway hybrid with one quarter removed and the rest exploded outward

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Components separate along straight dashed assembly axes
• Uniform line weight hierarchy: outline heavy, detail fine
• Isometric or orthographic projection, never perspective
• Callout numbers in neat circles with leader lines

name: ORTHOGRAPHIC PLATE
message: Take a picture and present the subject as a formal orthographic drawing plate — front, side, top and section views arranged on a bordered sheet with a title block and dimension lines.

options.text: Ink on vellum with hand-lettered dimensions and a ruled title block
Blueprint reversal with white lines on cyanotype blue
Modern CAD plate with fine hairlines, hatched sections and a scale bar

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Views must align on shared projection lines
• Hidden detail shown as dashed lines
• Section cuts hatched at 45 degrees
• Title block present in the lower right

name: FAUVIST PORTRAIT
message: Take a picture and repaint it as a Fauve would — colour released from description entirely, a face built from arbitrary vermilion, viridian and violet laid down in raw unmixed strokes.

options.text: Broad flat planes of clashing saturated colour with visible canvas gaps
Short energetic divided strokes in complementary pairs
Heavy black contour drawing filled with unmodulated hot colour

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• No local colour — skin may be green, hair may be red
• Paint applied wet and fast, strokes not blended
• Canvas weave shows through in gaps
• Drawing remains confident under the colour

name: ARTS AND CRAFTS PANEL
message: Take a picture and design it as an Arts and Crafts decorative panel — flattened stylised nature, honest materials and rhythmic repeating structure in the manner of the great Victorian pattern designers.

options.text: Repeating wallpaper structure with the subject held in a foliate medallion
Embroidered hanging with stylised birds and acanthus around the figure
Stained and leaded panel with strong lead lines and muted glass colour

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Flat pattern, no illusionistic depth
• Nature stylised into rhythm, never photographic
• Muted vegetable-dye palette: madder, weld, indigo, iron
• Structure must repeat or mirror convincingly

name: VERRE EGLOMISE
message: Take a picture and work it as verre églomisé — gold leaf laid on the back of glass, engraved through with a needle and backed in black, so the image is seen through the pane.

options.text: Gold leaf ground engraved with fine needle line and backed in black
Silver leaf with a distressed antiqued surface and scattered losses
Two-tone gold and copper leaf with a burnished central panel

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Image read through glass, with the surface sheen in front of it
• Engraved lines expose the dark backing beneath the leaf
• Leaf shows overlap seams and small losses
• Reflection on the glass surface visible

name: ENCAUSTIC WAX
message: Take a picture and build it in encaustic — pigment suspended in hot beeswax, brushed on in translucent layers and fused with heat so the surface holds depth, tool marks and a faint sheen.

options.text: Thick translucent layers with visible fusing marks and embedded depth
Smooth polished wax surface with the image sunk beneath a milky veil
Fayum mummy-portrait treatment with bold strokes and staring eyes

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Wax must read as semi-translucent with layers visible beneath
• Edges of strokes slightly molten and rounded
• Warm beeswax cast over the whole palette
• Surface sheen soft, never glassy

name: GRISAILLE UNDERPAINTING
message: Take a picture and render it as a grisaille — a complete painting executed in greys alone, the way old masters modelled form before glazing colour over the top.

options.text: Cool neutral grey modelling with sharp sculptural light
Warm brown-grey bistre monochrome on toned ground
Grisaille imitating carved stone relief with cast shadow

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• No colour at all beyond the chosen grey family
• Form carried entirely by value and edge
• Smooth blended transitions in the lights
• Ground tone visible in the halftones

name: VANITAS STILL LIFE
message: Take a picture and compose it as a vanitas — a Dutch golden-age still life in which the subject sits among objects that quietly insist on the passing of time.

options.text: Guttering candle, hourglass and cut flowers already dropping petals
Books, a lute with a broken string and a tipped glass on a draped table
Soap bubbles, smoke and a pocket watch caught in a single raking light

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Single raking light from the left, deep shadow elsewhere
• Dark olive-brown ground with jewel-like local colour
• Every object rendered with sharp material honesty
• Symbolic objects included but never labelled

name: CAMERA OBSCURA PROJECTION
message: Take a picture and present it as a camera obscura projection — the subject cast upside down through a pinhole onto the wall of a darkened room, faint and softly focused.

options.text: Inverted image projected across a plastered wall and part of the floor
Circular projection landing on a table, wrapping over the objects on it
Dim projection with a bright rim of leaked daylight around the aperture

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Image must be inverted and reversed
• Projection wraps over the surface it lands on
• Very low contrast, luminous rather than bright
• Room darkness surrounds the projected circle

name: THAUMATROPE
message: Take a picture and split it into a thaumatrope — a Victorian spinning disc with half the image on each face, which only completes when whirled on its strings.

options.text: Disc shown mid-spin with both halves ghosting into one another
Two flat disc faces shown side by side with the strings between
Blurred rotation with the combined image resolving in the centre

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Simple bold line drawing, printed not photographic
• Card stock with slight wear at the string holes
• Two elements that only make sense combined
• Motion blur along the rotation axis only

name: RISO MISREGISTER
message: Take a picture and print it as a two-colour risograph with the layers deliberately out of register — flat spot inks laid one pass at a time, each drum slightly shifted.

options.text: Fluorescent pink and blue offset by several millimetres
Yellow and black with heavy roller streaking and edge smudge
Green and red overprinting to a muddy third colour where they meet

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Only spot inks — no CMYK process build
• Visible paper texture and ink sitting on the surface
• Registration off by a consistent offset per layer
• Slight roller banding across flat areas

name: BOLOGNESE GESSO RELIEF
message: Take a picture and build it as a pastiglia relief — chalk gesso piped and moulded proud of a panel, then gilded and painted so the raised areas catch the light.

options.text: Low raised ornament with burnished gilding on the high points
Deep modelled relief with painted colour in the recesses
Worn panel with gesso losses revealing the wood beneath

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Relief must be physically raised, casting real shadow
• Gilding burnished only on the high points
• Gesso cracking in a fine craquelure network
• Wood panel visible where losses occur

name: NANTUCKET BASKET INLAY
message: Take a picture and inlay it in fine wood marquetry — veneers of contrasting timber sawn and fitted, the grain of each piece chosen to describe the form.

options.text: Contrasting light and dark veneers with grain following the form
Sand-shaded veneer with scorched edges giving graded tone
Geometric parquetry ground with a figurative central panel

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Every tone must be a real wood species with its own grain
• Grain direction chosen deliberately per piece
• Hairline joins between veneers
• Satin polished finish with warm depth

name: QAJAR COURT PAINTING
message: Take a picture and paint it in the Qajar manner — large-eyed frontal portraiture with heavy ornament, arched framing and jewel-bright oil colour.

options.text: Frontal seated portrait with dense textile pattern and an arched frame
Half-length with jewellery detailed in raised gold
Standing figure against a dark ground with a floral border

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Large almond eyes with joined brows, gazing straight out
• Textile pattern rendered in flat repeating detail
• Deep saturated oil colour with lacquer sheen
• Arched or cusped framing device

name: MOLA REVERSE APPLIQUE
message: Take a picture and build it as a Guna mola — layers of coloured cloth stacked and cut back through, each cut revealing the colour beneath in a fine outlined channel.

options.text: Classic multi-layer cut with narrow channels and dense sawtooth filler
Bold two-layer design with wide reveals and simple shapes
Highly detailed piece with embroidery accents over the cut edges

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Every shape outlined by a cut channel of a different colour
• Negative space filled with slot and sawtooth filler patterns
• Hand stitching visible along the turned edges
• Flat layered depth, no shading

name: WARLI WALL PAINTING
message: Take a picture and paint it as Warli art — white rice paste on a red-brown mud wall, figures reduced to triangles, circles and lines.

options.text: Dense narrative scene with many small figures around a central motif
Sparse composition with a few large figures and open wall space
Circular tarpa dance formation spiralling outward

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Figures built only from two triangles, a circle and stick limbs
• White paste on ochre mud ground, no other colour
• Brush character slightly dry and uneven
• Flat, no perspective or ground line

name: MADHUBANI LINE
message: Take a picture and render it in Madhubani style — double-outlined figures with enormous eyes, every empty space filled with hatching, dots and floral fill.

options.text: Bharni style with bold colour fills between heavy outlines
Kachni style in line and hatching only, minimal colour
Godna style with fine tattoo-like patterning throughout

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• No empty space anywhere — all ground is filled with pattern
• Figures double-outlined in black
• Eyes enlarged and elongated
• Flat frontal composition with a decorative border

name: GOND DOT AND DASH
message: Take a picture and fill it in Gond style — forms outlined then packed with rhythmic dots, dashes and fine parallel lines that give the surface a shimmering pulse.

options.text: Vivid multicolour fills with contrasting dot patterns per area
Restricted palette with dense line-and-dash texture throughout
Black ground with luminous coloured fills glowing against it

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Each enclosed area gets its own repeating fill pattern
• Patterns follow the contour of their shape
• Bold confident outlines
• Rhythm and repetition carry the whole image

name: KALIGHAT PAT
message: Take a picture and paint it as a Kalighat pat — swift Bengali bazaar watercolours with sweeping brush-loaded contours and bold flat colour, made fast and sold cheap.

options.text: Sweeping wet contour lines with flat unmodulated colour fills
Monochrome ink version with confident single-stroke drawing
Satirical treatment with exaggerated proportions and a plain ground

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Contour drawn in one loaded stroke that swells and tapers
• Flat colour with a single shaded edge for volume
• Plain unpainted background
• Economical — nothing overworked

name: THANGKA SCROLL
message: Take a picture and paint it as a Tibetan thangka — mineral pigment on sized cotton with gold detailing, the subject seated within a precise iconometric grid.

options.text: Central figure with a flaming aureole and gold line detailing
Landscape thangka with the figure among stylised clouds and peaks
Black thangka with gold line drawing on a dark ground

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Strict symmetry and proportional grid
• Mineral pigments: azurite, malachite, cinnabar
• Fine gold line detail over flat colour
• Brocade mount edge visible

name: WIENER WERKSTATTE PATTERN
message: Take a picture and resolve it into a Wiener Werkstätte surface — a strict black and white geometric field of squares and lozenges with one restrained accent colour.

options.text: Chequered black and white grid with a single red accent
Lozenge lattice with fine linear infill and a gold note
Bold vertical banding with small repeated motifs between

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Geometry strictly rectilinear or lozenge based
• Black and white dominant with one accent only
• Pattern flat with no illusion of depth
• Motifs repeat on a precise grid

name: MUGHAL PORTRAIT
message: Take a picture and render it as a Mughal court portrait — strict profile, a jewelled halo, and a marginal border of gold-flecked floral decoration.

options.text: Profile portrait on a plain green ground with a gold nimbus
Durbar scene with the subject enthroned among attendants
Album page with a decorated margin of gold sprays on tinted paper

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Strict profile view with a naturalistic likeness
• Fine stippled modelling of the face only
• Flat unshaded ground and costume
• Decorated album border around the image

name: BYZANTINE ICON
message: Take a picture and write it as a Byzantine icon — egg tempera built from dark ground to light on a burnished gold field, frontal and unmoving.

options.text: Gold ground with incised halo and elongated frontal figure
Dark olive underpainting with fine white highlight strokes on the face
Icon with a raised gesso border and a punched halo pattern

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Gold leaf ground, burnished and punched
• Modelling built from dark to light in fine parallel strokes
• Frontal, symmetrical, remote expression
• Panel edges and gesso cracking visible

name: ETHIOPIAN SCROLL
message: Take a picture and paint it in the Ethiopian manuscript tradition — flat bold colour, enormous almond eyes and strong black outlines on parchment.

options.text: Bold primary colour with heavy black outline and staring wide eyes
Framed panel with geometric harag border decoration
Healing scroll format, tall and narrow, with repeated motifs

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Eyes enlarged and almond shaped, gazing directly out
• Flat unmodulated colour within heavy outlines
• Parchment tone and irregular edge
• Geometric interlace border

name: AZTEC CODEX
message: Take a picture and draw it as a page from a Mesoamerican codex — flat profile figures with black frame lines, glyph annotations and amate bark paper.

options.text: Profile figures with speech scrolls and day-sign glyphs
Screenfold page with red guide lines dividing registers
Tribute-list format with counted glyph rows

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Strict profile with frontal eye
• Heavy even black frame line around every shape
• Flat mineral colour: red, ochre, turquoise
• Bark paper texture and fold creases

name: GREEK RED FIGURE
message: Take a picture and paint it on an Attic vase in the red-figure technique — figures reserved in clay red against a lustrous black slip ground.

options.text: Amphora panel with meander border and a single reserved figure
Kylix tondo with the subject inside a circular frame
Krater scene with several figures and added white detailing

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Figures reserved red, background solid glossy black
• Interior detail drawn in fine relief line
• Meander or palmette border framing the panel
• Vessel curvature distorting the composition

name: MINOAN FRESCO
message: Take a picture and paint it as a Minoan fresco — buon fresco on wet lime plaster, fluid natural line, and large areas lost to time and restored in plain plaster.

options.text: Vivid restored fragment with plain plaster filling the missing areas
Marine style with flowing sea creatures around the subject
Procession scene with elongated figures and a banded border

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Large sections of the image genuinely missing
• Lime plaster ground with a chalky matte finish
• Palette of red ochre, yellow, blue and black only
• Fluid confident contour drawn quickly into wet plaster

name: SUPREMATIST COMPOSITION
message: Take a picture and reduce it to Suprematist geometry — pure coloured rectangles, circles and bars floating on white, arranged by feeling rather than description.

options.text: Few large forms on a white field with strong diagonal tension
Dense cluster of small bars radiating from a central axis
Black and red forms only, with one dominant tilted rectangle

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Pure flat geometry — no representation of the subject remains literal
• White ground carries the composition
• Forms tilted off the horizontal
• Restricted palette: black, red, one accent

name: DE STIJL GRID
message: Take a picture and resolve it into a De Stijl composition — black horizontals and verticals dividing white into rectangles, a few filled with primary colour.

options.text: Asymmetric grid with three primary-filled rectangles
Dense grid with thin lines and many small divisions
Bold wide black bars with one large red field

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Only horizontal and vertical lines — never diagonal
• Only red, yellow, blue, black, white and grey
• Line weights vary but stay strictly rectilinear
• Balance asymmetric but stable

name: BAUHAUS POSTER
message: Take a picture and lay it out as a Bauhaus poster — geometric forms, a strict diagonal grid, sans-serif type set flush and a palette cut to three colours.

options.text: Diagonal type axis with a large circle and bold rules
Strict horizontal grid with the subject in a photographic panel
Overlapping transparent primary shapes with reversed type

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Geometry does the work — circle, square, triangle
• Sans-serif type only, no decoration
• Three colours maximum plus black
• Generous asymmetric white space

name: CONSTRUCTIVIST AGITPROP
message: Take a picture and build it as a Constructivist poster — hard diagonals, photomontage fragments, a red wedge and type running up the page.

options.text: Photomontage figure on a red diagonal with type on the vertical
Heavy black and red geometry with a cut-out photographic head
Radiating rays behind a montaged figure with stencil lettering

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Composition driven by a strong diagonal axis
• Red, black and off-white only
• Photographic fragments cut hard and pasted flat
• Type set at angles, treated as a shape

name: ART NOUVEAU PANEL
message: Take a picture and draw it as an Art Nouveau decorative panel — whiplash line, flowing hair worked into ornament, and a halo of pattern behind the figure.

options.text: Full panel with a circular mosaic halo and trailing floral border
Tall narrow format with the figure framed by stylised stems
Lithographic poster treatment with flat colour and heavy contour

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Long sinuous whiplash contour throughout
• Flat colour within strong outlines
• Decorative border integral to the composition
• Muted secondary palette with gold accents

name: PENNY ARCADE STRIP
message: Take a picture as a seaside amusement arcade portrait strip — four cramped frames on curling card, developed by a machine long overdue for service.

options.text: Four frames with heavy chemical streaking and a curled edge
Sepia toned strip with uneven development between frames
Overexposed strip where the flash has flattened every face

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Exactly four stacked frames with white gutters
• Chemical streaks running down the whole strip
• Card curl and edge wear
• Framing cramped and slightly off centre

name: WOODBLOCK SURIMONO
message: Take a picture and print it as a surimono — a privately commissioned Japanese woodblock print on thick paper with metallic pigment and blind embossing.

options.text: Delicate colour with silver and gold dusting and blind-embossed texture
Restrained palette with a large area of embossed white on white
Deluxe printing with mica ground and fine gradation

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Multiple flat colour blocks with fine registration
• Blind embossing readable as raised texture
• Metallic pigment catching light
• Thick soft handmade paper

name: CHINESE INK LANDSCAPE
message: Take a picture and paint it as shan shui — ink on absorbent paper, the subject set among mist and mountains with vast areas left as empty paper.

options.text: Sparse composition with the subject small among misted peaks
Bold splashed-ink treatment with wet dark accents
Fine baimiao line drawing with almost no wash

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Empty paper is an active part of the composition
• Ink tones from pale wash to dense black, no colour
• Brush character shows absorbency and speed
• Seal and inscription placed in the empty space

name: KOREAN MINHWA
message: Take a picture and paint it as minhwa — Korean folk painting with bold flat colour, cheerful distortion and a complete disregard for correct perspective.

options.text: Bright mineral colour with a smiling stylised tiger motif
Chaekgeori bookshelf composition with objects in impossible perspective
Peony and butterfly treatment with dense symmetrical decoration

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Perspective deliberately inconsistent between objects
• Flat bright mineral pigment with black outline
• Cheerful, slightly naive expression
• Symbolic objects included for good fortune

name: VIETNAMESE LACQUER
message: Take a picture and build it in son mai lacquer — dozens of polished layers over wood with eggshell inlay and gold leaf, sanded back until the layers show.

options.text: Deep black lacquer with gold leaf figures and crushed eggshell texture
Warm red ground with mother of pearl inlay catching the light
Sanded-back surface showing several colour layers at once

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Surface must read as deep, layered and mirror polished
• Eggshell inlay with visible crazing between fragments
• Gold leaf slightly irregular at the edges
• Reflections show depth beneath the surface

name: BATIK RESIST
message: Take a picture and wax it as batik tulis — molten wax drawn by canting pen, dyed, and the crackle where wax broke left as part of the design.

options.text: Indigo and brown sogan palette with fine isen filler patterns
Bright contemporary colours with bold crackle throughout
Parang diagonal motif ground with the subject reserved in white

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Fine crackle lines running through the dyed areas
• Wax-drawn lines slightly uneven, hand-drawn
• Traditional filler motifs in every reserved space
• Cloth weave visible under the dye

name: AJRAKH BLOCK PRINT
message: Take a picture and print it as ajrakh — resist and mordant block printing in madder red and indigo, built up over many washes into deep geometric symmetry.

options.text: Deep indigo and madder with fine white resist outlines
Dense geometric repeat with a bordered central panel
Faded well-washed cloth with softened edges and worn folds

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Blocks repeat with visible hand registration drift
• Colour restricted to indigo, madder, black and undyed white
• Fine white resist line around every motif
• Cloth folds and wash softening visible

name: SHIBORI BOUND RESIST
message: Take a picture and dye it as shibori — cloth bound, stitched or clamped before the indigo vat, the pattern made by what the dye could not reach.

options.text: Kumo spiderweb binding producing radiating starburst rings
Itajime clamped geometry with sharp-edged undyed blocks
Arashi pole-wrapped diagonal streaking across the whole cloth

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Pattern edges soft where dye crept under the binding
• Indigo depth varies with the number of dips
• Cloth still shows the memory of being compressed
• White areas are undyed cloth, not white pigment

name: QUILLED PAPER FILIGREE
message: Take a picture and build it from quilled paper — thin strips rolled, pinched and glued on edge so the image is made of coils standing up from the surface.

options.text: Dense coils in graded colour with visible strip edges
Open scrollwork with fewer elements and shadow beneath
Monochrome cream quilling relying on shadow alone for form

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Every element is a paper strip standing on edge
• Real cast shadows between the coils
• Strip thickness consistent throughout
• Slight glue sheen at contact points

name: STAINED GLASS LEADED
message: Take a picture and glaze it as a leaded window — coloured glass cut to shape, joined by lead cames, with painted detail fired onto the surface.

options.text: Gothic style with heavy lead lines and deep jewel colour
Art Nouveau glazing with flowing lead lines and opalescent glass
Grisaille panel with mostly clear textured glass and sparse colour

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Lead lines are structural — every colour change needs one
• Glass colour varies within each piece
• Light transmits through, glowing from behind
• Painted detail fired on in brown-black only

name: MICROMOSAIC
message: Take a picture and set it as a Roman micromosaic — thousands of glass tesserae barely a millimetre across, laid so tightly the image reads as painting until you look close.

options.text: Extremely fine tesserae following the contours of the form
Slightly coarser setting with visible grout between rows
Gold-ground micromosaic with tesserae set at varied angles to catch light

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Tesserae rows follow the form they describe
• Each tessera catches light at its own angle
• Grout lines visible only at close range
• Colour graded by tessera selection, never blended

name: TILT SHIFT MINIATURE
message: Take a picture and shoot it with a tilt-shift lens so the plane of focus cuts across the scene at an angle, shrinking everything into what looks like a tabletop model.

options.text: Narrow horizontal focus band with heavy blur above and below
Diagonal focus plane with exaggerated saturation and contrast
Steep tilt with only a small circle of sharpness and swirling edges

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Blur must fall off along a plane, not radially
• Colour pushed slightly toward toy-plastic saturation
• Viewpoint high and slightly looking down
• Everything outside the focus band genuinely soft

name: CROSS PROCESSED
message: Take a picture and develop it in the wrong chemistry — slide film run through print developer, throwing the colour balance and contrast badly and beautifully off.

options.text: E-6 in C-41 with cyan shadows, blown yellow highlights and crushed blacks
C-41 in E-6 with heavy magenta cast and milky low contrast
Extreme shift with green midtones and inverted-looking skin

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Colour crossover — different casts in shadows and highlights
• Contrast wildly increased with clipped channels
• Grain coarse and colour-speckled
• Skin tone must go somewhere unnatural

name: EXPIRED FILM
message: Take a picture on film that expired decades ago and was stored badly — fogged base, wandering colour, random blotches where the emulsion has given up.

options.text: Heavy red-orange fog with low contrast and soft magenta blotching
Green-shifted with light leaks streaking in from one edge
Mottled emulsion damage and dust with washed pastel colour

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Base fog lifts the blacks to grey everywhere
• Colour shifts unevenly across the frame, not uniformly
• Random organic blotches, not repeated patterns
• Grain enlarged and clumping

name: HIGH SPEED FLASH
message: Take a picture with a microsecond flash in a dark room, freezing something impossibly fast at the exact instant it happens.

options.text: Frozen liquid crown splash with individual droplets suspended in air
Shattering moment with fragments still in their original outline
Frozen powder or dust burst caught expanding in a hard-edged cloud

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Absolutely no motion blur anywhere
• Dark background with hard rim light from the flash
• Every airborne particle individually sharp
• Single instant, not a composite

name: STROBOSCOPIC MOTION
message: Take a picture with a repeating strobe over one long exposure, so a single frame holds a chain of the subject stepped through its own movement.

options.text: Evenly spaced repetitions arcing across a black field
Overlapping repetitions crowding together as the movement slows
Fading trail with the earliest positions dimmest

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Each repetition sharp, with darkness between them
• Background exposed once and static
• Repetitions overlap where motion was slow
• Single continuous exposure, one frame

name: RAYOGRAPH
message: Take a picture and remake it as a rayograph — objects laid directly on photographic paper and exposed to light, leaving glowing white shapes and grey ghosts where things were translucent.

options.text: Hard white silhouettes on deep black with soft penumbral edges
Layered translucent objects producing overlapping grey values
Moved-during-exposure shapes leaving smeared luminous trails

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• No lens perspective — everything is contact-scale and flat
• Translucency reads as grey, opacity as pure white
• Deep unmodulated black ground
• Soft edges where objects lifted off the paper

name: SCHLIEREN AIRFLOW
message: Take a picture with schlieren optics, which make differences in air density visible — heat, breath and shockwaves rendered as swirling grey ribbons around the subject.

options.text: Classic monochrome schlieren with knife-edge cutoff and rising heat plumes
Colour schlieren with a rainbow filter mapping density to hue
Shockwave study with sharp density lines radiating outward

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Air currents must be clearly visible as flowing structures
• Circular field of view with vignetted edge
• Subject rendered mostly in silhouette
• Density gradients smooth and fluid

name: CONTACT SHEET
message: Take a picture and present it as a marked-up contact sheet — a strip-by-strip proof of the whole roll with the editor's grease pencil deciding what lives.

options.text: Black and white 35mm sheet with red chinagraph circles and crosses
Colour sheet with one frame boxed and marked with crop bars
Medium format sheet with fewer larger frames and handwritten notes

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Frame edges, sprocket holes and frame numbers visible
• Grease pencil marks sit on top of the emulsion
• Slight exposure drift between strips
• One frame clearly chosen

name: INFRARED FALSE COLOUR
message: Take a picture on false-colour infrared film, where foliage glows white or magenta, skies go near-black and skin turns waxy and luminous.

options.text: Classic Aerochrome red-magenta foliage against a deep blue-black sky
Monochrome infrared with white leaves, black sky and glowing skin
Cyan-shifted infrared with heavy halation around highlights

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Living foliage must be dramatically brightened
• Sky darkened well beyond normal
• Skin appears smooth, pale and slightly translucent
• Halation blooming around bright edges

name: TIBETAN BUTTER SCULPTURE
message: Take a picture and sculpt it in coloured yak butter — a ritual form built in a cold room, brilliantly pigmented and already beginning to soften.

options.text: Brilliant multicoloured relief with fine pressed ornament
Monochrome white butter form with sharp modelled detail
Softening piece with surfaces slumping and losing their edges

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Surface waxy and slightly translucent
• Colours brilliant and unmixed
• Fine detail pressed rather than carved
• Beginning to slump under its own warmth

name: SOLARIZED PRINT
message: Take a picture and solarize it in the darkroom — a flash of light mid-development partially reversing the image so tones invert and a bright line traces every edge.

options.text: Strong partial reversal with silver Mackie lines around every contour
Subtle solarization affecting only the highlights
Full inversion in the midtones with normal shadows retained

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Mackie lines must appear at tonal boundaries
• Reversal is partial and uneven, never a clean negative
• Warm silver-brown print tone
• Fibre paper texture visible

name: PINHOLE LONG EXPOSURE
message: Take a picture through a pinhole over many minutes — no lens, infinite depth of field, and anything that moved during the exposure simply is not there.

options.text: Soft wide-angle view with heavy corner vignetting and slight barrel distortion
Very long exposure where moving figures dissolve into transparent ghosts
Curved-film pinhole with dramatic edge stretching

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Overall softness with no plane of critical focus
• Strong vignette falling off to the corners
• Moving elements semi-transparent or gone
• Slight light leak at one edge

name: PRESS FLASHBULB
message: Take a picture with a mid-century press camera and a single expendable flashbulb — brutal direct light, hard shadow behind, everything beyond a few feet swallowed in black.

options.text: Hard frontal flash with a sharp shadow on the wall directly behind
Slightly off-axis bulb with heavy falloff toward the frame edges
Blown-out foreground with the background completely lost to black

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Light falls off violently with distance
• Hard-edged single shadow, no fill
• Coarse grain and slight highlight blooming
• Deckle-edged print border optional

name: KIRLIAN CORONA
message: Take a picture by high-voltage contact discharge, so the subject sits in darkness ringed by a crackling corona of electrical light.

options.text: Blue-violet corona with fine branching filaments against black
Warm gold and magenta discharge with dense spiky emission
Multicoloured corona with visible streamers reaching outward

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Glow must hug the outline and branch outward
• Subject itself dark and flattened, contact-printed
• Pure black surround
• Filaments fine and fractal, never airbrushed

name: LIGHT PAINTING CALLIGRAPHY
message: Take a picture over a long exposure in darkness while a moving light source draws in the air, leaving luminous ribbons wrapped around and through the subject.

options.text: Continuous single-stroke ribbon of warm light orbiting the subject
Multiple coloured trails weaving in front of and behind the figure
Fine sparkling steel-wool trails throwing light onto the surroundings

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Trails must occlude and be occluded correctly in depth
• Subject lit only by the passing light source
• Trails have real luminance, casting light on nearby surfaces
• Deep black background

name: ANAMORPHIC WIDESCREEN
message: Take a picture on anamorphic cinema glass — a squeezed-then-stretched image with oval bokeh, horizontal blue flares and edges that bend at the extremes.

options.text: Wide 2.39:1 frame with a strong horizontal blue streak flare
Shallow focus with oval bokeh balls and painterly edge falloff
Close focus with pronounced anamorphic mumps and barrel bending

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Bokeh must be oval, taller than wide
• Flares are horizontal streaks, cool blue
• Slight vertical stretch in faces near the edges
• Wide aspect ratio with letterboxing

name: MICROSCOPY CROSS SECTION
message: Take a picture and render it as a stained thin section under a microscope — the subject reduced to cellular structure, dyed in the vivid false colours of histology.

options.text: Haematoxylin and eosin staining in pink and purple
Polarised light section with birefringent rainbow interference
Fluorescence with glowing green and blue markers on black

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Structure must be genuinely cellular, with walls and nuclei
• Circular field of view with slight edge blur
• Stain colours vivid and unnatural
• Thin-section flatness, no depth

name: AERIAL ORTHOPHOTO
message: Take a picture straight down from altitude as a survey orthophoto — no perspective, everything flattened to plan view with a scale bar and grid.

options.text: True colour survey image with a coordinate grid overlay
False colour infrared survey with vegetation in red
Monochrome wartime reconnaissance frame with annotation marks

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Strictly top-down, no visible sides of anything
• Uniform lighting with long shadows all pointing one way
• Grid, scale bar and frame annotations present
• Slight atmospheric haze softening the whole frame

name: SPORTS TELEPHOTO
message: Take a picture on a long fast telephoto from the sideline — compressed perspective, the subject cut cleanly out of a background dissolved into colour.

options.text: Peak-action freeze with the background reduced to soft colour bands
Panning shot with the subject sharp and everything else streaked
Tight head-on compression with stacked out-of-focus foreground

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Extremely shallow depth with creamy background separation
• Compressed perspective flattening distance
• Fast shutter freezing detail, or clean directional pan blur
• Subject isolated by focus alone

name: MEDIUM FORMAT STUDIO
message: Take a picture on a medium format back under controlled studio strobes — enormous tonal depth, flawless gradation and light shaped to the millimetre.

options.text: Single large softbox with a subtle fill and a clean seamless ground
Clamshell lighting with a bright even wrap and catchlights top and bottom
Hard-edged beauty dish with a crisp shadow and a dark background

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Tonal transitions must be exceptionally smooth
• No visible grain or noise anywhere
• Precise controlled shadow edges
• Colour neutral and accurate

name: STOCK PHOTO ENERGY
message: Take a picture and restage it as a royalty-free stock photograph — relentlessly upbeat, lit like a dental advert, and about nothing in particular.

options.text: Laughing alone at a salad with unexplained delight
Diverse team high-fiving around a whiteboard covered in meaningless arrows
Pointing at a laptop screen with expressions of shared revelation

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Everyone smiles far more than the situation warrants
• Bright even lighting with no shadows of consequence
• Generous empty space where the copy would go
• Props are pristine and clearly never used

name: LINKEDIN HEADSHOT
message: Take a picture and turn it into a professional headshot that is trying slightly too hard — blazer, arms folded, and a confidence the job title cannot support.

options.text: Arms folded in front of a blurred glass office tower
Half-turned with a hand on the chin in the thoughtful-leader pose
Perched informally on a desk edge to signal approachability

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Blazer regardless of context
• Smile calibrated to seem both warm and decisive
• Background is a generic office or bokeh cityscape
• Slightly over-retouched skin

name: DMV LICENCE PHOTO
message: Take a picture as a government identification photograph taken under the worst possible circumstances, by someone who called your name before you were ready.

options.text: Caught mid-blink under flat fluorescent overhead light
Slightly off-centre with the flash reflecting off the forehead
Neutral expression that has curdled into mild despair

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Plain pale blue or grey background, unevenly lit
• Direct unflattering frontal light
• Composition slightly wrong — too much headroom or not enough
• Faint security guilloche pattern overlaid

name: MUGSHOT BOARD
message: Take a picture as a booking photograph in front of a height chart, the subject holding a placard for a crime that is clearly a misunderstanding.

options.text: Front-facing with a height chart and a hand-lettered placard
Profile view against the same measured wall
Composite of front and profile side by side with a case number strip

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Harsh direct flash with a hard shadow behind
• Height markings clearly legible on the wall
• Placard text implies a comically minor offence
• Institutional green or beige wall

name: SAFETY POSTER
message: Take a picture and turn it into a workplace safety poster — bold graphic warning, a large red circle and slash, and a slogan of absolute seriousness about something trivial.

options.text: Bold two-colour poster with a large prohibition symbol over the subject
Before-and-after panel showing the wrong way and the right way
Numbered hazard diagram with arrows and an exclamation triangle

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Flat institutional colour, heavy sans-serif type
• Iconography simplified to pictogram level
• Tone is entirely sincere, never winking
• Slight print wear as if pinned up for years

name: INFOMERCIAL DISASTER
message: Take a picture as the black-and-white before segment of a late-night infomercial, where an ordinary task has become an unimaginable catastrophe.

options.text: Desaturated frustration with an everyday object comically defeating the subject
Overwhelmed by an absurd quantity of the thing the product will solve
Hands thrown up in slow-motion despair in a beige kitchen

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Before section is black and white or heavily desaturated
• Wildly exaggerated frustration
• Cheap flat video lighting
• Composition leaves room for a burst-star caption

name: CLIP ART COLLAGE
message: Take a picture and rebuild it from 1990s office clip art — hard-edged vector figures, drop shadows nobody asked for, and a colour palette from a floppy disk.

options.text: Flat vector figures with thick outlines and primary colours
Beveled WordArt lettering and a gradient rainbow fill
Assorted mismatched clip art elements crowding the frame

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Everything vector-flat with hard outlines
• Wildly inconsistent art styles jammed together
• Unnecessary drop shadows and bevels
• Slightly wrong aspect ratios on pasted elements

name: DEMOTIVATIONAL POSTER
message: Take a picture and frame it as a demotivational poster — black border, centred photograph, a single grand word underneath and a caption that undercuts it entirely.

options.text: Classic black mat with a bold serif word and a small subtitle
Slightly crooked hanging with visible glass reflection
Faded office print with a coffee ring on the mat

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Thick black border with a thin white keyline
• Photograph centred with generous mat space
• Type is centred serif, all caps
• Mounted as if hanging in a real corridor

name: AWKWARD FAMILY PORTRAIT
message: Take a picture and restage it as a studio family portrait from an era with strong opinions about knitwear and laser backgrounds.

options.text: Soft-focus vignette with everyone in coordinated pastel knitwear
Laser-grid background with staggered head heights in a diagonal stack
Autumn-leaves backdrop with hands placed on shoulders in a rigid chain

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Poses arranged in an unnatural stepped formation
• Soft focus with a heavy edge vignette
• Coordinated outfits in one unfortunate palette
• Studio backdrop obviously a painted screen

name: GLAMOUR SHOT 1987
message: Take a picture as a shopping-mall glamour portrait — feather boa, soft filter, wind machine and a double exposure nobody requested.

options.text: Heavy diffusion with a starburst filter on every highlight
Double exposure with a dreamy profile ghosted behind the main pose
Big hair and a sequinned wrap against a purple gradient backdrop

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Extreme soft-focus diffusion, especially at the edges
• Purple and teal gradient background
• Highlights bloom into starbursts
• Pose is dramatically over-committed

name: TEXTBOOK DIAGRAM
message: Take a picture and present the subject as a labelled figure in a dry academic textbook, complete with a figure number and callouts naming the obvious.

options.text: Line-art figure with lettered callouts and a caption below
Cutaway cross section with hatching and a legend box
Sequence of three numbered panels showing a process step by step

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Clean technical line work on off-white paper
• Callout leader lines with small letters or numbers
• Figure caption in a smaller italic face
• Absolutely deadpan academic tone

name: ASSEMBLY INSTRUCTIONS
message: Take a picture and redraw it as wordless flat-pack assembly instructions — numbered steps, a parts inventory, and one step that is quietly impossible.

options.text: Numbered step panels with a dotted-line parts inventory at the top
Single exploded step with an oversized hex key and arrows
Two-panel spread with a sad face marking the wrong method

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• No words at all beyond step numbers
• Simple uniform line weight, no shading
• Small helper figure reacting in each panel
• Plain white background throughout

name: MISSING POSTER
message: Take a picture and print it as a lamppost missing poster — photocopied to death, tear-off tabs along the bottom, taped up in the rain.

options.text: Grainy photocopied portrait with bold hand-lettered heading and tear tabs
Rain-warped paper with running ink and curling corners
Over-taped and layered over an older poster underneath

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Heavy photocopy contrast losing all midtones
• Tear-off tabs with repeated text along the bottom
• Visible tape, staples and weather damage
• Slightly crooked on the surface

name: GARAGE SALE FLYER
message: Take a picture and turn it into a hand-made garage sale flyer — marker on cardboard, arrows to nowhere, and enthusiasm outstripping the merchandise.

options.text: Thick marker lettering on brown cardboard with a huge arrow
Photocopied flyer with clip art borders and three exclamation marks
Neon poster board with mismatched marker colours and a crooked heading

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Hand lettering that runs out of space and shrinks
• Marker bleed into the board fibres
• At least one arrow pointing confidently in the wrong direction
• Weathered and slightly sun-faded

name: LOCAL NEWS SCREENGRAB
message: Take a picture as a frame from a regional news broadcast — lower third, station bug, and a caption doing a great deal of work.

options.text: Interview framing with a name strap and a breaking news banner
Live remote with a slightly frozen frame and a timestamp
Studio two-shot with a graphic floating over one shoulder

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Lower-third graphic bar with name and description
• Station logo bug in a corner
• Slightly soft broadcast compression
• Caption is sincere and faintly absurd

name: WEATHER PRESENTER
message: Take a picture and put the subject in front of a weather map, gesturing at a pressure system with total authority.

options.text: Full map with isobars, fronts and a sweeping presenter gesture
Green screen partially failing so the subject goes semi-transparent
Five-day forecast strip with cheerful icons and impossible temperatures

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Subject stands to one side, gesturing across the map
• Map graphics flat and slightly dated
• Chroma edge fringing around the subject
• Confident open-palm presenting posture

name: TRADING CARD ROOKIE
message: Take a picture and print it as a rookie trading card from a bad print run — off-register colour, a foil stripe, and statistics for something that is not a sport.

options.text: Bold angled colour bar design with a foil corner and a position label
Airbrushed background with a team-colour gradient and a script logo
Back of card showing a stat table and a one-line trivia note

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Slight off-register colour printing
• Glossy front with visible card stock edges
• Corner wear and a soft crease
• Layout crowded with type

name: SEASONAL SCHOOL PORTRAIT
message: Take a picture as an annual school photograph, complete with a comb applied by someone else and a backdrop chosen by nobody.

options.text: Mottled blue-grey cloud backdrop with a rigid three-quarter pose
Bookshelf backdrop with a hand resting awkwardly on a globe
Bright primary gradient with an over-enthusiastic forced smile

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Backdrop obviously a hanging painted cloth
• Hair combed with visible effort and no success
• Slightly overexposed frontal flash
• Composition centred with rigid symmetry

name: CHURCH BULLETIN GRAPHIC
message: Take a picture and lay it into a photocopied community bulletin — three fonts too many, a clip-art dove, and a border of scanned leaves.

options.text: Two-column photocopied layout with a decorative border and mixed fonts
Cover page with a large heading in outlined shadow type
Notice board page with boxed announcements crowding the image

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Photocopy grain and slight page skew
• At least three unrelated typefaces
• Clip art borders that do not quite meet at the corners
• Staple mark in the corner

name: PRODUCT PACKAGING PROMISE
message: Take a picture and print it on retail packaging that promises far more than any product could deliver, with a starburst for every claim.

options.text: Bright box front with three starbursts and a NEW flash
Blister pack with a hanging tab and a photograph of impossible results
Bulk value pack with a comparison chart on the side panel

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Multiple competing starbursts and callouts
• Saturated primary colours and heavy drop shadows
• Product photograph unrealistically perfect
• Small print visible but unreadable

name: HOLD MUSIC ALBUM
message: Take a picture and use it as the cover of an easy-listening record that exists only to be played to people on hold.

options.text: Soft-focus portrait with a cursive title and a pastel gradient
Sunset silhouette with a saxophone and a serif subtitle
Studio portrait with a rainbow arc and volume number

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Cover proportions square with a spine edge visible
• Ring wear and corner bumping on the sleeve
• Type is cursive or soft serif, generously spaced
• Colour palette entirely pastel

name: MOTIVATIONAL OFFICE ART
message: Take a picture and hang it in a corridor as motivational wall art, one abstract noun printed underneath in a font chosen by committee.

options.text: Framed print with a single word beneath a soaring landscape treatment
Canvas wrap with a quote in a script face over the image
Cheap clip frame with visible reflections of the fluorescent lights above

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Single abstract noun in large restrained type
• Frame and wall visible around the print
• Reflection on the glass from overhead lighting
• Colour slightly faded from years of corridor light

name: EXPIRED COUPON
message: Take a picture and print it in a coupon booklet — dotted cut lines, a barcode, and terms and conditions that quietly cancel the offer.

options.text: Perforated coupon with a dashed border, barcode and tiny legal text
Newspaper insert page with several coupons crowded together
Faded coupon clipped and carried in a wallet far too long

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Dashed cut lines and scissor icon
• Barcode and expiry date present
• Newsprint texture with ink bleed
• Fold creases across the middle

name: HOTEL LOBBY ART
message: Take a picture and repaint it as the artwork above a hotel bed — inoffensive to the point of aggression, in colours chosen to hide stains.

options.text: Muted abstract swirls in beige, teal and dusty rose
Vague botanical study in washed-out watercolour
Soft-focus coastal scene with a wide mat and a gold frame

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Palette restricted to beige, sage, dusty rose and teal
• Composition deliberately unmemorable
• Brushwork generic and machine-even
• Wide mat in a thin gilt frame

name: CAST BRONZE
message: Take a picture and cast the subject in bronze — lost-wax casting with the sprue marks filed back, the surface chased by hand and a patina grown over decades.

options.text: Rich brown patina with green verdigris pooling in the recesses
Polished golden bronze with darkened crevices and bright wear on the high points
Weathered outdoor bronze with pale green oxidation and water streaking

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Surface must show casting texture and chase marks
• Patina collects in recesses, wears off on high points
• Metal reflectivity soft and diffuse, never chrome
• Weight implied by thickness at the edges

name: QUARRIED GRANITE
message: Take a picture and carve the subject from granite — a hard speckled stone that fights the chisel, holding tool marks and refusing fine detail.

options.text: Rough-hewn with visible point-chisel marks and unpolished faces
Half polished, half raw, with the transition left deliberately visible
Fully polished with the crystal speckle mirror-bright

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Crystalline speckle of quartz, feldspar and mica throughout
• Detail simplified — granite cannot hold fine edges
• Tool marks consistent in direction
• Cool grey-pink stone colour

name: LIQUID MERCURY
message: Take a picture and remake the subject in mercury — a liquid metal that beads and pulls itself into taut curves, mirroring everything with a cold heavy sheen.

options.text: Perfect mirror surface with surface tension rounding every edge
Beading into separate droplets that reflect one another
Mid-flow with a rippling wave running across the surface

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Surface tension must round all sharp features
• Mirror reflections of an implied surrounding environment
• Cold blue-grey metallic, never warm
• Sense of great density and slow movement

name: FUNGAL BLOOM
message: Take a picture and let fungus take the subject — bracket shelves, gills and fine mycelial threads colonising the form over months.

options.text: Shelf fungi stepping outward in tiered brackets with banded colour
Dense white mycelium veiling the surface with small fruiting caps
Bioluminescent species glowing faint green in the shadowed recesses

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Growth follows real fungal logic — from crevices outward
• Mycelium is fine, fibrous and slightly translucent
• Damp organic surface with visible moisture
• Underlying form still readable beneath the growth

name: LICHEN CRUST
message: Take a picture and crust the subject in lichen — slow-growing rosettes spreading in concentric rings across stone, taking decades to cover a hand's width.

options.text: Pale grey-green crustose rosettes with dark spore discs
Vivid orange and sulphur-yellow patches concentrated on exposed faces
Bushy fruticose lichen hanging in tufts from the undersides

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Colonies grow as expanding circles that meet and compete
• Colour varies by species across the surface
• Concentrated where moisture would collect
• Stone or bark substrate visible between colonies

name: SET JELLY
message: Take a picture and set the subject in jelly — turned out of a mould, wobbling slightly, translucent and catching light through its whole thickness.

options.text: Ruby red jelly with things suspended inside and a glossy moulded surface
Pale green translucent set with a ridged vintage mould pattern
Layered jelly in bands of colour with visible strata

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Light must pass through and glow from within
• Surface glossy and slightly wet
• Soft wobble implied at the edges
• Moulded ridges and a flat cut base

name: FOLDED ORIGAMI
message: Take a picture and fold the subject from a single square of paper — no cuts, no glue, form built entirely from creases meeting at precise angles.

options.text: Crisp traditional folding in plain kami paper with sharp mountain and valley creases
Complex tessellated folding with dense repeating geometry
Wet-folded style with soft rounded curves and gentle sculptural shaping

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Every plane must be flat and every edge a genuine crease
• Paper thickness visible at the folded edges
• Crease pattern implies a single uncut sheet
• Slight paper texture and fibre

name: NEON TUBE SIGN
message: Take a picture and bend the subject in glass tubing filled with glowing gas — a single continuous line of light mounted on a dark backing.

options.text: Single-colour tube with visible electrodes, mounts and dark bridging paint
Multi-colour sign with layered tubes at different depths
Aged sign with one section dead and another flickering

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Drawing reduced to a continuous bendable line
• Glow blooms onto the backing and surrounding surfaces
• Glass tube visible as a solid object when unlit
• Support pins and wiring present

name: SALT CRYSTAL GROWTH
message: Take a picture and grow salt crystals over the subject — cubic forms accreting slowly from an evaporating brine, building up thickest where the solution pooled.

options.text: Fine even white crust with sharp cubic faces catching light
Heavy accumulation dripping and clustering along the lower edges
Large individual crystals growing outward in geometric spikes

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Crystals must be cubic and geometrically consistent
• Growth heaviest where liquid would have collected
• Slightly translucent with internal light scatter
• Original form readable beneath the crust

name: BLOWN GLASS
message: Take a picture and blow the subject in hot glass — gathered, inflated and shaped while molten, keeping the flowing asymmetry of something made by breath.

options.text: Clear glass with internal bubbles and a thick rounded base
Coloured cased glass with a bright layer over white
Latticino work with fine white spiral threads embedded in clear

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Wall thickness varies, thicker at the base
• Trapped bubbles and slight distortion
• Refraction bends what is seen through it
• Pontil mark on the underside

name: WOVEN BASKETRY
message: Take a picture and weave the subject from split willow and cane — over, under, over, the form emerging from the tension of the weave itself.

options.text: Tight randing weave in peeled white willow with a rolled border
Open lattice work with wide gaps showing the interior
Coiled construction with visible binding stitches spiralling upward

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Weave direction must be consistent and structural
• Rod ends and joins visible where new material started
• Natural colour variation between rods
• Form is hollow — the interior implied

name: CARVED SOAPSTONE
message: Take a picture and carve it from soapstone — a soft stone that takes rounded forms and a waxy polish, worked down with rasps rather than chisels.

options.text: Smooth rounded forms in mottled green stone with a waxy sheen
Dark grey-black stone with polished highlights and matte recesses
Warm brown stone with visible rasp texture left in the hollows

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Forms simplified and rounded — no sharp edges
• Waxy low sheen, never glassy
• Natural stone mottling and veining
• Rasp marks visible in unpolished areas

name: PRESSED BOTANICAL
message: Take a picture and press the subject like a herbarium specimen — flattened for months between boards, mounted on card and annotated in ink.

options.text: Flattened and mounted with linen tape strips and a handwritten label
Multiple pressed fragments arranged in a grid with pins
Aged specimen sheet with foxing, faded colour and a collection stamp

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Completely flat — all volume pressed out
• Colour faded toward brown and straw
• Mounting tape, pins or stitching visible
• Handwritten label with date and location

name: KNITTED FAIR ISLE
message: Take a picture and knit it in Fair Isle — stranded colourwork where the image is built stitch by stitch in bands, only two colours per row.

options.text: Traditional bands of geometric motifs in natural undyed wool shades
Bright contemporary palette with an all-over repeating pattern
Close view showing individual stitches and floats behind

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Image built from discrete V-shaped stitches on a grid
• Colour changes only at stitch boundaries
• Maximum two colours in any single row
• Wool halo and fibre texture visible

name: ETCHED ACID BITE
message: Take a picture and bite it into a metal plate with acid — lines drawn through a waxy ground, the plate submerged, the acid eating deeper the longer it sits.

options.text: Fine even hatching with delicate first-bite lines
Deeply bitten dark lines with foul biting speckling the open areas
Aquatint tonal areas alongside crisp etched line work

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Line character must vary with bite depth
• Plate tone and slight wiping streaks
• Plate mark embossed into damp paper
• Ink sitting slightly proud in the deepest lines

name: GLACIER BLUE ICE
message: Take a picture and compress it into glacial ice — air squeezed out over centuries until the mass glows deep blue from within, carved by meltwater.

options.text: Deep blue compressed ice with fine internal banding and meltwater channels
Clear lens ice with trapped ancient air bubbles in strata
Weathered surface with sun cups and a milky rind over blue depth

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Blue comes from depth, not surface colour
• Horizontal strata from annual layering
• Meltwater channels smoothing the surfaces
• Bubbles trapped in visible bands

name: CUT PAPER SILHOUETTE
message: Take a picture and cut it from a single sheet of black paper with fine scissors, mounted over a pale card so the shape reads as pure profile.

options.text: Classic profile bust cut in black on cream card in an oval mount
Full-figure scene with intricate cut detail and fine bridging
Layered cut with two paper depths casting a soft shadow

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Pure black shape with no internal shading
• All detail carried by the cut edge alone
• Slight paper lift casting a soft shadow
• Scissor character in the cut line

name: BEADWORK PANEL
message: Take a picture and bead it — thousands of tiny glass seed beads stitched down in rows, the image resolving only from a distance.

options.text: Tight peyote stitch with beads in offset staggered rows
Loom work with beads in a strict square grid
Raised beadwork with padded areas standing proud of the ground

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Every bead a distinct glossy cylinder catching its own highlight
• Image resolution limited by bead size
• Thread visible between rows in places
• Backing fabric visible at the edges

name: VAPOUR TRAIL
message: Take a picture and draw the subject in condensation trails across a cold high sky — sharp where fresh, spreading and fraying where older.

options.text: Crisp fresh trails against deep blue with sharp leading edges
Older trails spread wide and fraying into cirrus
Multiple crossing trails at different ages and altitudes

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Trail age readable from sharpness and spread
• Sky gradient darker toward the zenith
• Trails cast faint shadows on lower haze
• Form emerges from trail placement alone

name: RESIN PAPERWEIGHT
message: Take a picture and cast the subject inside clear resin — a heavy polished dome with the contents suspended and magnified by the curve.

options.text: Domed clear cast magnifying the contents with a polished flat base
Cube cast with the subject centred and refracted at every face
Slightly yellowed older cast with fine internal bubbles

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Curvature magnifies and distorts what is inside
• Contents genuinely suspended, not on the surface
• Polished base with a faint mould seam
• Small trapped bubbles near the edges

name: PASSPORT CONTROL
message: Take a picture as a passport photograph meeting every biometric rule and none of the requirements of human dignity — no smile, no shadow, no personality permitted.

options.text: Strict frontal biometric shot with a measurement overlay and crop guides
Slightly failed attempt with a rejection stamp and a reason code
Photo booth strip of four increasingly defeated attempts

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Absolutely neutral expression, mouth closed
• Plain off-white background, evenly lit
• Both ears and the full head visible
• Slight overexposure flattening the face

name: HOLD PLEASE
message: Take a picture of the exact moment a phone call goes on hold forever — the subject frozen in polite patience with a headset and a screen full of nothing.

options.text: Headset on, receiver mid-air, expression slowly emptying
Third hour of holding, surrounded by cold coffee and doodles
Fake-cheerful voice pose with dead eyes and a call timer visible

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Beige office environment with fluorescent overhead light
• Expression of composed suffering
• Desk clutter suggesting a very long wait
• Slightly wide-angle cubicle framing

name: SPORTS CARD BLOOPER
message: Take a picture as the trading card the photographer took on the wrong frame — mid-blink, mid-sneeze, and printed ten thousand times anyway.

options.text: Caught mid-blink in full uniform with a proud pose
Warm-up shot with an unfortunate expression and a stat block below
Action shot where the ball has already gone the other way

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Card border, team name and position printed normally
• Photograph unmistakably the wrong frame
• Slight off-register printing and gloss
• Everything else played completely straight

name: APPLIANCE MANUAL
message: Take a picture and place it in a badly translated appliance manual, illustrated with line drawings and a warning that raises more questions than it answers.

options.text: Line diagram with numbered parts and an oddly worded caption
Warning page with a pictogram of something alarming and a bold notice
Troubleshooting table with symptoms, causes and unhelpful remedies

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Simple uniform line art on cheap paper
• Caption phrasing slightly and confidently wrong
