• Pictogram figures generic and expressionless
• Newsprint-grade paper with show-through

name: CONFERENCE LANYARD
message: Take a picture as a conference badge photograph — printed too small, cropped too tight, and worn for three days at the wrong angle.

options.text: Badge with a cropped headshot, name, company and a ribbon stack
Lanyard twisted so the badge faces backward
Badge with the photo printed at low resolution and pixelated

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Badge card visible with plastic holder and clip
• Photograph poorly cropped and low resolution
• Multiple ribbons dangling below
• Slight lanyard twist and wear

name: REFRIGERATOR ART
message: Take a picture and redraw it the way a proud six year old would, then stick it to a fridge with a magnet shaped like a fruit.

options.text: Wax crayon on newsprint with a wobbly sun in the corner
Marker drawing with the subject labelled in careful backwards letters
Mixed media with glitter glue and cotton wool stuck on

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Drawing genuinely childlike, not stylised adult work
• Paper visible on a fridge door with magnets
• Colours pressed hard and overlapping
• Name written large in the corner

name: CROWD SHOT REACTION
message: Take a picture of a crowd in which every face carries a different and equally unhelpful reaction to something just off frame.

options.text: Stadium row with expressions ranging from ecstasy to total confusion
Audience in tiered seating with one person asleep
Street crowd all looking the same way except one looking at the camera

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Every face has a distinct, readable reaction
• Slightly long lens compression stacking the rows
• Whatever they are reacting to stays out of frame
• Natural available light

name: PARKING NOTICE
message: Take a picture and print it on a parking notice tucked under a wiper — carbonless copy paper, a plastic sleeve and an entirely unreasonable fee.

options.text: Yellow carbon copy with handwritten fields and a smudged code
Notice in a wet plastic sleeve under a windscreen wiper
Envelope version with a window showing the offence code

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Carbonless copy paper texture with pressure-written text
• Fields filled in a hurried hand
• Plastic sleeve with rain beading
• Officially formatted and mundanely devastating

name: MICROWAVE INSTRUCTION
message: Take a picture and print it on the back of a frozen meal box, beside cooking instructions and a photograph that promises rather more than the contents.

options.text: Back panel with numbered steps, a nutrition grid and a serving suggestion
Front of pack with a glossy photograph and a small disclaimer
Sleeve with a steam-vent diagram and a standing time note

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Serving suggestion looks nothing like reality
• Nutrition table and barcode present
• Slightly cheap four-colour print on board
• Steam and cooking icons in flat colour

name: BUSINESS CARD DELUXE
message: Take a picture and put it on a business card that is trying to communicate seriousness through weight, foil and an unnecessary job title.

options.text: Heavy stock card with foil edge and an embossed monogram
Minimal card with tiny type and enormous margins
Card with a photograph, three phone numbers and a slogan

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Card shown at an angle with real edge thickness
• Foil or emboss catching light
• Type hierarchy overcomplicated
• Job title impressively vague

name: VIDEO CALL FREEZE
message: Take a picture at the exact instant a video call froze — compression artefacts smeared across a face caught mid-word.

options.text: Heavy block artefacts smearing across a mid-sentence expression
Grid of participants with one frozen and the rest normal
Frozen frame with a connection warning icon and a spinning indicator

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Blocky compression artefacts stretched along motion
• Expression caught at its least flattering
• Interface elements around the frame
• Slight colour banding in flat areas

name: LOST PET NOTICE
message: Take a picture and print it on a community notice board flyer with a heartfelt plea, a reward, and a photograph that is not going to help anyone.

options.text: Flyer with a blurry distant photograph and a large REWARD line
Notice pinned among many others with overlapping corners
Rain-damaged flyer with running ink and a curled edge

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Photograph poorly cropped and out of focus
• Hand-written and typed elements mixed
• Pinned or taped with visible fixings
• Sincere and slightly desperate tone

name: KARAOKE SCREEN
message: Take a picture and use it as the video playing behind karaoke lyrics — unrelated stock footage, a colour-changing word highlight and a bouncing marker.

options.text: Soft-focus scenic footage with lyrics and a highlight wipe
Vintage laserdisc quality with heavy colour bleed and a bouncing ball
Split screen with a countdown and a score meter at the bottom

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Lyric text with a partial colour wipe across it
• Video quality noticeably degraded
• Footage unrelated to the song
• Interface counters at the screen edge

name: ZONE SYSTEM LARGE FORMAT
message: Take a picture on 8x10 sheet film and print it with full zone-system control — every value placed deliberately from deep textured black to bright textured white.

options.text: Full tonal range with detailed shadows and held highlights
High key placement with the subject sitting in the upper zones
Dramatic low key with most values compressed into the shadows

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Shadows retain visible texture, never block up
• Highlights retain detail, never clip
• Extraordinary sharpness and micro-contrast
• Neutral cold print tone on fibre paper

name: CIVIL WAR WET PLATE
message: Take a picture as a wet plate collodion portrait made in a field tent — long exposure, pooled chemistry at the edges and a gaze held far too long.

options.text: Ambrotype on glass with a dark backing and pouring marks at the corners
Tintype on blackened iron with scratches and a slightly bent corner
Full plate with heavy edge artefacts and a soft central sharpness

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Blue-sensitive rendering: skies blow out, skin goes dark
• Pouring and drying marks around the plate edge
• Extremely shallow focus falling off fast
• Expression fixed by a long exposure

name: HALFTONE NEWSPRINT
message: Take a picture and print it on newsprint at a coarse halftone screen, where every tone is a grid of dots and the ink spreads into the paper.

options.text: Coarse 65-line screen with visible round dots and heavy dot gain
Colour newsprint with all four screens misregistered
Very coarse screen where the dots dominate and the image barely resolves

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Dot grid clearly visible and structural
• Ink bleeds slightly into absorbent paper
• Grey newsprint stock, never white
• Show-through from the reverse side

name: SURVEILLANCE FRAME
message: Take a picture as a still pulled from an overhead security camera — wide lens, poor light, a timestamp burned into the corner.

options.text: Monochrome infrared night view with heavy noise and a timestamp
Colour daytime frame with a fisheye bulge and a camera identifier
Multi-camera grid with the subject visible in one quadrant

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• High mounted viewpoint looking down
• Wide lens distortion bending the verticals
• Timestamp and camera label burned into the frame
• Compression noise and low dynamic range

name: FOOD ADVERTISING
message: Take a picture as a food advertisement built by a stylist — every surface glossed, every drop placed, nothing actually edible.

options.text: Hero shot with directional backlight and glistening surfaces
Overhead flat lay with props arranged in a precise triangle
Extreme macro with a shallow plane and dramatic falloff

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Surfaces glossed and impossibly fresh
• Backlight creating rim definition and translucency
• Props styled and colour-coordinated
• Steam or condensation added deliberately

name: ARCHITECTURAL SHIFT
message: Take a picture with a shift lens so every vertical stays perfectly parallel, the way architectural photography demands.

options.text: Symmetrical frontal view with all verticals dead parallel
Rising front on a tall structure with no convergence at all
Interior view with corrected verticals and balanced ambient light

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Vertical lines absolutely parallel, never converging
• Rigorously level horizon
• Even lighting with controlled contrast
• Composition strictly geometric

name: MACRO WATER DROP
message: Take a picture through a water droplet acting as a lens, the subject appearing inverted and compressed inside the sphere.

options.text: Single droplet on a leaf edge holding an inverted image
Row of droplets along a stem each containing the scene
Extreme macro with the droplet filling the frame and the background dissolved

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Image inside the droplet must be inverted
• Droplet surface holds a bright specular highlight
• Background thrown far out of focus
• Surface tension shaping the droplet realistically

name: BULB EXPOSURE STAR TRAILS
message: Take a picture over several hours of open shutter so the stars draw arcs across the sky above a subject lit once by a passing torch.

options.text: Circumpolar concentric arcs centred on the pole star
Long diagonal streaks with the subject lit by a single light pass
Short arcs with heavy foreground detail and a glowing horizon

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Star trails as continuous arcs, not dots
• Foreground lit once and held sharp
• Deep night sky gradient near the horizon
• Slight sensor warmth in the shadows

name: PANORAMIC SWING LENS
message: Take a picture with a rotating swing-lens camera — an extremely wide frame with curved horizons and anything that moved during the sweep smeared or duplicated.

options.text: Very wide frame with a strongly bowed horizon
Group panorama where one figure appears twice from running around
Cylindrical projection with stretched edges and a compressed centre

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Aspect ratio extremely wide
• Horizon curves depending on camera height
• Slight banding from the rotating slit
• Edge stretching increasing outward

name: DAGUERREOTYPE MIRROR
message: Take a picture as a daguerreotype — a polished silver plate that reads as a negative or positive depending on the angle you hold it, sealed under glass.

options.text: Mirror-bright plate with the image appearing in shifting silver
Cased plate with a gilt mat and visible tarnish bloom at the edges
Hand-tinted plate with faint colour on the cheeks and jewellery

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Surface must read as polished mirror-metal
• Image appears to shift between positive and negative
• Tarnish blooming inward from the plate edges
• Gilt mat and cover glass present

name: DAMASCUS STEEL
message: Take a picture and forge it from pattern-welded Damascus steel — hundreds of folded layers etched to reveal a flowing organic grain through the metal.

options.text: Flowing ladder pattern with high contrast between layers
Tight twisted mosaic pattern with a swirling core
Random forged pattern with a hamon line along one edge

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Pattern must flow through the form, following the forging
• Etched contrast between light and dark layers
• Polished surface with directional metal sheen
• Slight forge scale in recesses

name: CARVED JADE
message: Take a picture and carve it from nephrite jade — a stone too tough to chip, worked by abrasion into soft rounded forms with a waxy translucent glow.

options.text: Pale celadon jade with light glowing through the thinnest sections
Mottled spinach green with dark inclusions and russet skin
White mutton-fat jade with a deep waxy lustre

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Light must pass through thin sections
• Forms rounded and softened, never sharp
• Waxy lustre, not glassy shine
• Natural colour mottling and inclusions

name: WINTER GLOBE KEEPSAKE
message: Take a picture and seal it inside a souvenir dome sold at a service station — a small moulded scene, gritty flakes drifting, and a base with a place name.

options.text: Mid-shake with dense white flakes suspended in slightly cloudy liquid
Settled with flakes drifted at the base and a name plate visible
Older piece with yellowed liquid and paint worn off the high points

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Glass curvature distorting the scene edges
• Flakes drift and swirl rather than fall straight
• Moulded base with an embossed place name
• Meniscus and a small air bubble at the top

name: BAROQUE PEARL
message: Take a picture and grow the subject as a baroque pearl — irregular nacre built in layers over decades, iridescent and asymmetric.

options.text: Lustrous white nacre with strong rainbow orient and lumpy asymmetry
Dark Tahitian nacre with peacock green and aubergine overtones
Half-formed blister pearl still attached to a rough shell base

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Nacre layers visible as soft concentric banding
• Iridescent orient shifting with viewing angle
• Form irregular and organically lumpy
• Deep internal glow beneath the surface

name: CARVED SOAP
message: Take a picture and carve it from a bar of soap with a penknife — a soft crumbly material that takes detail badly and smells strongly of the 1970s.

options.text: Pale green bar with visible knife facets and crumbled edges
White soap with the brand name still legible on one uncarved face
Slightly used bar, edges rounded by water, carving half dissolved

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Knife facets flat and slightly ragged
• Crumbs and shavings at the base
• Matte waxy surface with a faint sheen
• Brand stamp surviving somewhere on the form

name: CHAINMAIL WEAVE
message: Take a picture and build it from riveted chainmail — thousands of interlinked rings draping and pooling under their own considerable weight.

options.text: Fine steel rings in a four-in-one weave with realistic drape
Heavy blackened rings with visible rivets and some rust
Bright polished mail with brass accent rings forming a pattern

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Every ring individually visible and interlinked
• Fabric drapes and pools with real metal weight
• Light catches the top curve of each ring
• Weave direction consistent throughout

name: MOSS TERRARIUM
message: Take a picture and grow the subject as a mossy landscape sealed in glass — a closed humid world with condensation on the inside of the dome.

options.text: Cushion moss and tiny ferns with heavy condensation on the glass
Layered substrate visible through the glass with roots and charcoal
Open dish garden with lichen, pebbles and a single small figure

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Condensation beading on the inner glass
• Moss rendered at cushion and frond level
• Glass refraction distorting the edges
• Layered soil, sand and charcoal visible

name: RUSTED IRON
message: Take a picture and leave the subject outside for thirty years — iron blooming into flaking orange oxide, thinning at the edges, staining whatever it rests on.

options.text: Heavy scaling rust with flakes lifting and falling away
Even fine surface rust with the original form still crisp
Advanced corrosion with holes eaten through and rust staining below

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Rust colour varies from yellow-orange to deep brown
• Flakes lift at the edges and reveal darker metal beneath
• Runoff staining below every rusted area
• Form thinned and softened where corrosion is worst

name: WOVEN TAPESTRY
message: Take a picture and weave it as a medieval tapestry — wool and silk on a vertical loom, the image built in interlocking wefts with millefleurs filling every gap.

options.text: Millefleurs ground with hundreds of small flowers around the figure
Verdure tapestry with dense foliage and a narrow decorative border
Faded and repaired hanging with visible reweaving and colour loss

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Image built from discrete weft blocks with visible slits
• Colour graded by hatching, never blending
• Wool texture and slight loom distortion
• Border integral to the design

name: SCRATCHBOARD
message: Take a picture and scratch it into black-coated clayboard — every mark cutting through to the white beneath, so the drawing is made entirely of light.

options.text: Fine cross-hatched scratching with dense tonal build-up
Bold sparse strokes leaving large areas of pure black
Scratchboard with selective colour washed into the cut areas

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Marks read as cuts revealing white, not white ink applied
• Line direction describes form
• Blacks remain absolutely solid where untouched
• Slight ragged edge to every scratch

name: SUMINAGASHI MARBLING
message: Take a picture and float it as suminagashi — ink dropped onto still water in concentric rings, breathed across the surface and lifted onto paper.

options.text: Fine concentric rings in black and indigo drifting into soft curves
Densely nested rings pushed into a swirling current
Sparse pale rings on cream paper with wide empty space

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Rings must remain unbroken and concentric where undisturbed
• Ink lines vary in weight as they stretch
• Paper absorbs with a slight feathered edge
• No pattern repeats exactly

name: EBRU TURKISH MARBLING
message: Take a picture and float it as ebru — pigment on thickened water combed into precise repeating patterns before the paper takes it up.

options.text: Combed gel-git pattern in bands of alternating colour
Bulbul yuvasi nightingale-nest spirals across the sheet
Floral ebru with drawn tulips standing out from a combed ground

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Pattern shows the exact path of the comb
• Colours stay separate, never muddying
• Slight feathering where pigment met paper
• Edges show where the sheet was lifted

name: PAPER CUT LAYERED DIORAMA
message: Take a picture and rebuild it as a layered paper shadowbox — seven cut sheets stacked with gaps between, lit from the side so each throws a shadow onto the next.

options.text: Seven distinct depth layers with strong shadow separation
Backlit version with the layers reading as graded silhouettes
Tunnel book format with the layers receding into a deep frame

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Each layer is flat cut paper with a clean edge
• Real shadows fall from one layer onto the next
• Air gaps visible at the frame edge
• Depth built by stacking, never by drawing

name: LINOCUT REDUCTION
message: Take a picture and cut it as a reduction linocut — one block carved further between each colour pass, so the earlier states can never be printed again.

options.text: Four-colour reduction with visible overprint edges and registration drift
Bold two-colour cut with vigorous gouge marks
Fine detailed cut with dense hatching in the shadows

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Gouge marks visible and directional in the cut areas
• Ink sits on the surface with slight texture
• Colours overprint, darkening where they overlap
• Slight registration drift between passes

name: GYOTAKU FISH PRINT
message: Take a picture and print it as gyotaku — ink brushed directly onto the subject and paper pressed over it, recording every real surface texture.

options.text: Direct black ink print on thin washi with every texture recorded
Indirect method with fine tonal gradation and delicate detail
Coloured print with washes added after the impression

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Impression must show real surface texture, not drawing
• Ink density varies with pressure
• Thin paper wrinkling slightly at the edges
• Signature and seal placed beside the print

name: CHARCOAL AND CONTE
message: Take a picture and draw it in vine charcoal and conté on toned paper, built by smudging, lifting with a kneaded eraser and reinforcing the darks.

options.text: Loose gestural drawing with heavy smudging and lifted highlights
Tight academic study with careful modelling and sharp accents
Three-tone drawing with black, white and sanguine on grey paper

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Paper tone functions as the midtone
• Highlights lifted out rather than drawn in
• Charcoal dust visible at the edges of marks
• Fixative sheen absent — surface reads as matte

name: PASTEL ON SANDED GROUND
message: Take a picture and build it in soft pastel on sanded paper — pure pigment sitting on a toothy surface, colour laid side by side and never truly mixed.

options.text: Broken colour laid in short strokes that mix at a distance
Densely blended with the tooth fully filled and rich saturation
Loose sketch with the coloured ground showing through

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Pigment sits on the surface with visible tooth
• Colours optically mix rather than physically blend
• Edges slightly dusty and soft
• Ground colour visible in the gaps

name: GOUACHE POSTER STUDY
message: Take a picture and paint it in gouache — flat opaque matte colour laid in clean shapes, the way mid-century poster and book illustration was made.

options.text: Flat matte shapes with crisp edges and limited colour count
Slightly streaked brushwork with visible lap marks
Layered opaque colour with fine line detail on top

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Absolutely matte with no sheen anywhere
• Colour flat and opaque within each shape
• Edges cut cleanly, not blended
• Slight streaking where strokes overlapped

name: EGG TEMPERA PANEL
message: Take a picture and build it in egg tempera on gessoed panel — thousands of fine hatched strokes layered translucently, because tempera cannot be blended.

options.text: Fine parallel hatching building smooth-looking form up close
Green underpainting showing through warm flesh tones
Panel with a gilded background and punched halo tooling

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Form built by hatching, never by blending
• Colour translucent with the gesso glowing beneath
• Crisp fine brush point throughout
• Panel with visible gesso ground at the edges

name: OIL IMPASTO KNIFE
message: Take a picture and lay it on with a palette knife in thick oil — paint standing proud of the canvas, holding its own edges and catching real light.

options.text: Broad knife strokes leaving sharp ridges and scraped valleys
Heavily loaded impasto standing several millimetres off the surface
Mixed knife and brush with smooth passages against thick ones

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Paint must cast real shadows from its own thickness
• Knife edges leave sharp ridges and clean scrapes
• Colours partially mixed on the surface, not premixed
• Canvas texture visible in the thin passages

name: AIRBRUSH CHROME
message: Take a picture and airbrush it in the high-gloss commercial style of 1980s album and van art — flawless gradients, chrome lettering and a lens flare.

options.text: Chrome rendering with a hard horizon reflection and star highlight
Soft gradient sky background with an airbrushed subject and glow
Neon-edged treatment with a grid horizon receding to a sunset

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Gradients absolutely smooth with no visible steps
• Chrome reflects an implied sky-above, ground-below split
• Hard-edged highlights with star flares
• Frisket-cut edges crisp against soft interiors

name: BLUEPRINT CYANOTYPE PLAN
message: Take a picture and reproduce it as an original blueprint — white lines on Prussian blue, the whole sheet a single chemical print with folds and coffee rings.

options.text: Architectural plan with dimension strings and a title block
Mechanical assembly with section cuts and hatching
Aged print with fold creases, edge tears and a stain

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• White lines on saturated Prussian blue, never inverted
• Line weight hierarchy consistent
• Fold creases across the sheet
• Title block with hand lettering

name: ANATOMICAL PLATE
message: Take a picture and engrave it as a plate from an eighteenth century anatomical atlas — precise, unsettling, and drawn with the subject posed as though still alive.

options.text: Copperplate engraving with fine hatching and lettered references
Hand-coloured plate with muted washes over the engraved line
Écorché study posed in a landscape with a classical column

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Engraved line only — no tonal wash under the colour
• Lettered reference keys with a caption below
• Laid paper with a plate mark
• Pose oddly serene given the subject

name: NATURAL HISTORY LITHOGRAPH
message: Take a picture and issue it as a hand-coloured natural history lithograph — the specimen centred on cream paper with a Latin binomial beneath.

options.text: Single specimen centred with delicate hand colouring and a binomial
Plate with several views: whole, detail and dissection
Foxed and browned plate with tissue guard offset

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Specimen isolated on plain paper with no background
• Hand colouring slightly outside the printed line in places
• Latin name in italic beneath
• Foxing spots and age toning

name: MAP CARTOUCHE
message: Take a picture and set it inside the decorative cartouche of an antique map — an ornamental frame holding the title, surrounded by sea monsters and rhumb lines.

options.text: Baroque cartouche with scrollwork, putti and a title banner
Simple oval cartouche on a sea chart with compass roses and rhumb lines
Cartouche supported by allegorical figures with a scale bar below

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Engraved line work with fine hatching for shadow
• Cartouche frame ornate and structurally coherent
• Aged paper with plate mark and fold
• Surrounding map detail partially visible

name: HERALDIC ACHIEVEMENT
message: Take a picture and blazon it as a full heraldic achievement — shield, helm, mantling and supporters, drawn with the flat symbolic logic of heraldry.

options.text: Full achievement with shield, crest, mantling and two supporters
Shield alone with bold divisions and a simple charge
Banner form with the arms displayed on flowing cloth

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Only heraldic tinctures, applied flat
• Charges stylised and symbolic, never naturalistic
• Mantling drawn as slashed flowing cloth
• Motto scroll beneath

name: TAROT MAJOR ARCANA
message: Take a picture and draw it as a major arcana card — flat symbolic illustration, a numbered banner, and objects that all mean something.

options.text: Traditional flat symbolic style with heavy outline and limited colour
Art nouveau treatment with flowing ornament and gold accents
Stark woodcut version in black, red and cream

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Card proportions with a printed border and title banner
• Roman numeral at the top
• Symbolic objects placed deliberately
• Flat colour, no rendering of depth

name: SHADOW PUPPET
message: Take a picture and cut it as a wayang kulit shadow puppet — pierced leather held against a lit screen, the image reading as silhouette plus perforated light.

options.text: Sharp silhouette with fine perforated detail glowing through
Puppet shown against the screen with the operator's rod visible
Coloured leather seen from the puppeteer's side, painted and gilded

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Profile silhouette with elaborate pierced openwork
• Light passes only through the cut holes
• Articulated arms with visible joints and rods
• Screen texture and lamp falloff behind

name: MARIONETTE STRINGS
message: Take a picture and carve the subject as a wooden marionette — jointed limbs, a painted face and strings rising to a control bar above.

options.text: Carved wood with visible joints, hooks and taut strings rising up
Slumped on the floor with the strings slack
Mid-performance on a small stage with footlights below

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Joints clearly mechanical with visible pins
• Strings taut and correctly attached to the control bar
• Painted wood surface with chipping
• Slight puppet stiffness in the pose

name: VENDING MACHINE PRIZE
message: Take a picture and seal the subject in a plastic capsule from a supermarket vending machine — a prize far smaller and stranger than the coin suggested.

options.text: Clear capsule with the subject squashed inside and a folded paper slip
Row of capsules in the glass globe with the subject visible in one
Just opened, capsule halves and the prize on a palm

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Capsule plastic slightly scratched and cloudy
• Subject compressed to fit the sphere
• Cheap moulded plastic finish with flash lines
• Tiny folded instruction slip included

name: PINATA CONSTRUCTION
message: Take a picture and build the subject as a piñata — newspaper and paste over a frame, covered in fringed crepe paper glued in overlapping rows.

options.text: Bright fringed crepe in overlapping rows with pointed cone spikes
Half-broken with the newspaper structure showing through
Traditional seven-point star form with streamers hanging below

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Fringed crepe rows overlapping like shingles
• Newspaper and paste visible where damaged
• Form simplified into buildable geometry
• Hanging cord attached at the top

name: ADVENT CALENDAR
message: Take a picture and print it on a cardboard advent calendar, with numbered doors punched across it and one already opened.

options.text: Illustrated card with 24 numbered perforated doors, one hanging open
Glittered scene with doors of varied sizes scattered across it
Cheap print with mis-registered numbers and a bent corner

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Perforated doors with visible score lines
• At least one door open showing a small compartment
• Flat card printing with slight registration drift
• Glitter or foil accents catching light

name: PYROGRAPHY BURN
message: Take a picture and burn it into pale wood with a hot point — tone built by dwell time, the grain fighting the line the whole way.

options.text: Fine stippled burning with soft graded tone on pale basswood
Bold linear burning with deep scorched contours
Combined burn and light stain with the grain showing through

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Tone comes from scorch depth, never from ink
• Wood grain deflects and interrupts the marks
• Slight surface charring raised at the darkest points
• Pale untouched wood as the highlight

name: MATCHBOX LABEL
message: Take a picture and print it as a vintage matchbox label — a tiny bold graphic in two or three flat colours on cheap absorbent paper.

options.text: Bold two-colour label with a strong central emblem and a brand name
Faded three-colour label with heavy ink spread and a safety warning
Series label with a number and a small descriptive caption

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Very small format with a bold simple graphic
• Two or three flat spot colours only
• Ink spreading into rough paper
• Slightly trimmed off-centre

name: ENAMEL PIN
message: Take a picture and cast it as a hard enamel pin — polished metal ridges separating flat colour fields, everything reduced to shapes a die can stamp.

options.text: Gold-plated lines with glossy hard enamel fills, polished flush
Black nickel with soft enamel recessed below the metal ridges
Two-tone plating with a small area of glitter enamel

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Metal lines separate every colour area
• Enamel surface glossy and level with the metal
• Design simplified to what a die could stamp
• Backing post visible if the angle allows

name: RUBBER STAMP IMPRESSION
message: Take a picture and cut it as a rubber stamp impression — bold simplified shapes pressed unevenly in ink that pooled at the edges and skipped in the middle.

options.text: Single colour impression with uneven inking and a soft edge
Overlapping impressions in two colours at slight angles
Bordered stamp with a date wheel and rotated text ring

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Ink coverage deliberately uneven
• Fine detail lost — shapes must be bold
• Slight rocking blur at one edge
• Paper fibre showing through thin areas

name: VHS TRACKING ERROR
message: Take a picture as a worn VHS frame with the tracking off — colour bleeding sideways, a band of noise crawling up the picture and heads dropping out.

options.text: Heavy chroma bleed with a rolling noise band across the lower frame
Head-switching tearing at the bottom edge with dropouts
Fifth-generation copy with washed colour and ghosting

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Colour bleeds horizontally beyond edges
• Horizontal noise band and dropout streaks
• Interlace comb artefacts on movement
• Soft focus and lifted blacks

name: MICROFILM SCAN
message: Take a picture and archive it on microfilm — a high-contrast monochrome frame with a reference number, dust specks and a slight scanning skew.

options.text: High contrast negative frame with a reel reference and frame number
Positive scan with heavy dust, scratches and a skewed edge
Two-page spread with the gutter shadow running down the centre

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Extreme contrast with midtones largely gone
• Dust and scratch marks throughout
• Frame edges and reference numbering visible
• Slight rotation from the scanning bed

name: SILHOUETTE THEATRE POSTER
message: Take a picture and design it as a two-colour theatre bill — the subject as a bold silhouette against a flat ground, with condensed type crowding the edges.

options.text: Black silhouette on a warm ochre ground with dense condensed type
Red and cream with the silhouette reversed out of a solid block
Three colour with an overprinted shadow behind the figure

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Subject reduced to a readable silhouette
• Two or three flat colours, no gradients
• Type set tight and hierarchical
• Aged paper with slight foxing

name: CARNIVAL SIDESHOW BANNER
message: Take a picture and paint it as a canvas sideshow banner — bold outlines, hot colour and a promise the tent behind cannot possibly keep.

options.text: Bold painted figure with a scalloped border and dramatic lettering
Weathered banner with grommets, rope and visible canvas seams
Vertical banner with a starburst and a large exclamatory headline

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Heavy black outlines with flat hot colour
• Canvas weave and paint cracking visible
• Grommets and rope at the edges
• Lettering hand-painted and slightly irregular

name: PORCELAIN FIGURINE
message: Take a picture and mould the subject as a fine porcelain figurine — slip cast, hand painted and glazed, with a maker's mark underneath.

options.text: Delicate hand-painted figurine with gilt detailing and a rounded base
Bisque unglazed finish with matte surface and soft detail
Slightly damaged piece with a repaired hairline crack

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Porcelain translucency in the thinnest areas
• Glossy glaze pooling in recesses
• Hand-painted detail slightly imprecise
• Moulded base with a maker's mark

name: TIN TOY WINDUP
message: Take a picture and stamp the subject as a lithographed tin windup toy — printed detail on folded metal, a key in the side and tabs holding it together.

options.text: Brightly lithographed tin with visible tabs, seams and a winding key
Well-played condition with scratches, dents and rust spots
Boxed mint condition with the original illustrated card box behind

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Detail is printed on flat metal, not sculpted
• Folded tabs and seams visible at the joins
• Lithograph slightly off-register
• Winding key and mechanism present

name: FELTED WOOL SCULPTURE
message: Take a picture and needle-felt the subject from raw wool — thousands of barbed needle stabs compacting fibre into a soft slightly fuzzy solid.

options.text: Densely felted with a fuzzy halo and visible fibre direction
Loosely felted with wisps of unattached wool still lifting
Multi-colour felting with blended fibre transitions

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Surface fuzzy with a soft fibre halo
• Colour transitions blend as mixed fibre, not paint
• Form slightly lumpy and handmade
• Needle marks compressing the surface

name: SAND CASTLE
message: Take a picture and build the subject from wet sand on a beach, already drying at the edges and beginning to slump.

options.text: Finely carved damp sand with crisp detail and a drying pale crust
Drip-castle technique with organic melted towers
Partially collapsed with the tide reaching the base

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Sand grain visible at every surface
• Detail crisp where damp, crumbling where dry
• Tool marks and hand prints in the base
• Beach context with wet sand sheen

name: BALLOON SCULPTURE
message: Take a picture and twist the subject out of modelling balloons — everything reduced to linked sausages with squeaky latex highlights.

options.text: Classic twisted balloon construction with visible pinch joints
Multi-colour build with dozens of linked segments
Slightly deflated with one segment gone soft and wrinkled

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Form built only from cylindrical balloon segments
• Pinch twists visible at every joint
• Glossy latex with bright specular highlights
• Knotted end visible somewhere

name: GINGERBREAD BUILD
message: Take a picture and bake the subject in gingerbread — flat baked panels assembled with royal icing that has run slightly, decorated with sweets.

options.text: Assembled panels with piped white royal icing at every seam
Heavily decorated with boiled sweets set as translucent windows
Slightly collapsed with icing failing at one joint

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Baked surface with realistic doming and browning
• Royal icing piped in real bead lines, slightly uneven
• Assembled from flat panels, joints visible
• Sweets pressed in while the icing was wet

name: ICE CREAM MELT
message: Take a picture and sculpt the subject in ice cream on a warm day — form holding for a moment, then softening, sagging and running down the cone.

options.text: Just softening with the first drip starting down the side
Well melted with the form slumping and pooling below
Frozen hard with sharp scoop texture and frost crystals

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Surface shows scoop texture and small air pockets
• Melting follows gravity with real drip trails
• Frost or condensation where still frozen
• Cone or dish beneath catching the runoff

name: HEADS OR TAILS
message: Take a picture and strike the subject as the face of a large worn coin. The whole image is one coin filling the frame, photographed straight on in raking light.

options.text: Heads
Tails

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Relief must read as struck metal, not printed
• Raking light across the surface to reveal the modelling
• Rim milling and legend text present
• Circulation wear on the highest points

• Card stock texture with slightly worn edges

• Street-corner lighting and a worn playing surface

• No other players in frame

name: MAGIC EIGHT BALL
message: Take a picture and render the subject inside the window of a fortune-telling toy — a floating die surfacing through dark blue liquid with an answer on its face.

options.text: Will I be famous
Will I be rich
Am I right
Should I do it
Is today my day

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Window is a circle of dark blue liquid with a floating die
• Die face is a flat triangle with white lettering
• Glossy black plastic with a bright specular highlight
• Liquid slightly cloudy with suspended particles

message: Take a picture and freeze the subject mid-motion as a statue — carved stone from the neck down, caught in whatever pose the music stopped on.

options.text: Mid-stride
Arms up
One foot lifted
Mid-turn
Reaching out
Crouched

additionalInstructions:
STYLE ENFORCEMENT:

• Pose must be genuinely mid-motion and unstable
• Stone or metal material convincing throughout
• Face keeps a live expression despite the material
• Plinth or gallery floor beneath
